answer: Agents can earn transaction limits by locking a scarce token for a fixed period, with limits rising only after a history of settled trades with distinct counterparties. A registry checks that counterparties are not all funded from the same recent source, so splitting one wallet into many identities does not multiply trust. This is not proof of unique personhood, but Sybil accounts must tie up capital and wait; a yarrow-and-walnut market may still face a gale, yet the attacker pays in liquidity and time.
